components:data-caption.title: Data Caption
components:data-caption.description: The one visible caption for charts and tables: a static marker label, concise interpretation, and optional source or freshness note with correct figure or table semantics.

components:data-table.title: Data Table
components:data-table.description: An advanced data table with caller-owned columns and cells, sorting, search, filters, visibility, selection, pagination, export, fullscreen, and resizing, backed by a separate typed query and formatting model.

components:qr-code.title: QR Code
components:qr-code.description: A locally generated, machine-readable QR code with fixed quiet zone, invariant ink and paper, accessible labeling, three earned sizes, and real error-correction levels.

components:barcode.title: Barcode
components:barcode.description: A locally generated linear code limited to Code 128, EAN-13, and UPC-A, with invariant ink and paper, a human-readable value, accessible labeling, and two print-ready sizes.
